meta.title: U.S. Wholesale Mobile Devices | My Tech Stop
meta.description: My Tech Stop buys and sells mobile devices in bulk. Wholesale Apple, Samsung, and electronics for retailers, resellers, distributors, and international buyers. Pricing on request.

hero.title: U.S. Wholesale Mobile Devices. Built for Resellers.
hero.support: Wholesale Apple, Samsung and mobile electronics for retailers, resellers, distributors and international buyers.
hero.note: Inventory changes throughout the day. A sales representative confirms the current price.

inventory.title: Categories we buy and sell
inventory.body: These are product categories, not a live stock list. Availability changes frequently. Request a price for what you need today.

buy.title: Wholesale devices for resellers and businesses
buy.body: My Tech Stop sells mobile devices and electronics in bulk. Tell us the models, quantities, and conditions you need. The sales team confirms what is available.

sell.title: Have inventory? We buy.
sell.body: Send a model list, quantities, and condition. The buying team follows up. A file can be attached as XLSX, CSV, or PDF.

international.title: U.S. inventory. Global business.
international.body: Serving international wholesale buyers. Export inquiries are welcome. Supplying resellers and businesses worldwide.
international.note: Markets shown here are buyer markets. They are not offices or warehouses.
international.mapLabel: Markets where wholesale buyers are served

operations.title: Inventory, shipments, and the work in between.
operations.body: Photography from current operations can replace these graphics. Nothing on this page is a stock count or a shipment total.

insights.title: What wholesale buyers usually need to confirm.
insights.body: Short guidance only. These are not published market reports, and they are not a promise of stock.

cta.title: Ask for today’s pricing.
cta.body: Buyers can request a quote. Sellers can submit inventory. WhatsApp is available when a sales number is configured.

footer.summary: My Tech Stop buys and sells mobile devices in bulk from the United States. Pricing and availability are confirmed by the sales team.
